verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents worldwide VAT calculation and zero-tax results explained by a `taxability_reason` field. A beta user reports it handles VAT automatically based on customer address and VAT numbers, and another user confirms VIES validation exists, though it runs only once and cannot be re-triggered, so periodic compliance re-validation falls to the developer. missing for 10: first-party documentation of tax ID validation against official registries, explicit documentation of when reverse charge is applied, and ongoing or re-triggerable real-time validation.
